entries.name: Kushaya nitrogen
entries.signs: Kuita yellow kunotanga kumuromo wemashizha ekare ari pasi kuchienda nepakati peshizha sechimiro cheV; miti inochenuruka uye haikuri.
entries.checkInField: Enzanisa mashizha ari pasi neari kumusoro; yeuka kuti fetiraiza yakaiswa rini; enzanisa nemutsetse wakaiswa fetiraiza zvakanaka.

entries.name: Mvura yakawandisa muvhu
entries.signs: Kuita yellow kana pepuru uye kusakura munzvimbo dzakaderera dzemunda mushure memvura yakawanda; midzi mitsvuku, mishoma, kana inonhuwa.
entries.checkInField: Tarisa kana mvura yakamira kana ivhu rakanyorova mushure memvura; chera muti mumwe chete wotarisa kana midzi yaora kana kunhuwa.

entries.name: Kushaya mvura muvhu
entries.signs: Mashizha anopeta kana kumonereka uye anoita grey, kunyanya masikati; miti inodzoka usiku kana dambudziko riri diki.
entries.checkInField: Chera 10 cm pasi: kana ivhu richiparara rakaoma, mvura shoma. Tarisa kana mashizha achivhurika mangwanani.

entries.name: Kushaya sulfur
entries.signs: Mashizha matsva ari kumusoro anoita yellow yakachenuruka, dzimwe nguva aine mitsetse pakati petsinga; miti haikuri.
entries.checkInField: Enzanisa mashizha matsva ari kumusoro neekare ari pasi. Zvinowanzoitika muvhu rejecha risina manyowa.

entries.name: Kushaya potassium
entries.signs: Mashizha ekare anoita yellow ozoita brown kumicheto asi pakati pachiri girini; madzinde asina simba anogona kuwira pasi.
entries.checkInField: Tarisa micheto yemashizha ari pasi kuti haina kutsva yellow-brown pakati pachiri girini.

entries.name: Kushaya phosphorus
entries.signs: Miti midiki yakasvibira zvakanyanya ine micheto nemiromo yemashizha yakaita pepuru kana tsvuku; kukura kunononoka pakutanga.
entries.checkInField: Tarisa kana ruvara rwepepuru rwuri pamiti midiki munzvimbo yose; enzanisa nemiti yembeu imwe chete kune imwe nzvimbo.

entries.name: Kushaya zinc
entries.signs: Mitsetse mikuru michena kana yellow yakachenuruka kumativi ose epakati peshizha pamashizha matsva; madzinde mapfupi.
entries.checkInField: Tarisa mashizha matsva kuti ane mitsetse mikuru yakachenuruka inotangira pazasi peshizha.

entries.name: Mhashu yefall armyworm (makonye)
entries.signs: Maburi akashata nenzvimbo dzinoonekera pamashizha; tsvina yakanyorova inenge hupfu mumoyo wechibage; makonye ane Y yakatarisa pasi pamusoro.
entries.checkInField: Famba sechimiro cheW, tarisa miti 20: vhura moyo wechibage, tsvaga tsvina nemakonye. Nyora kuti mingani pa20 yakakuvara.

entries.name: Gonye remudzinde (stalk borer)
entries.signs: Mitsetse yemaburi madiki pamashizha paanovhurika; shizha repakati rakafa; migero mukati medzinde.
entries.checkInField: Dhonza shizha repakati: kana richibuda uye rakaora pazasi, tsemura dzinde utarise migero kana makonye.

entries.name: Chirwere chemitsetse (maize streak virus)
entries.signs: Mitsetse mitete yellow yakadambuka inotevera tsinga dzemashizha matsva, yozobatana; miti haikuri kana yabatwa ichiri midiki.
entries.checkInField: Bata shizha idiki uritarise nechiedza; tsvaga mitsetse mitete yellow yakadambuka inotevera tsinga. Verenga miti yabatwa.

entries.name: Chirwere chinouraya chibage (MLN)
entries.signs: Yellow ine mavara, yozooma kubva kumicheto ichipinda mukati; shizha repakati rinofa; miti inogona kufa kana miguri kuora.
entries.checkInField: Nyora kuti miti mingani iri kuoma kubva kumicheto uye kana mashizha epakati akafa. Zivisa mudzidzisi wezvekurima.

entries.name: Mavara egrey pamashizha (grey leaf spot)
entries.signs: Mavara marefu, mitete akaita sebhokisi egrey kana brown anomira patsinga, achitangira pamashizha epasi kana kuchinyorova.
entries.checkInField: Tarisa mashizha epasi kuti ane mavara akaita sebhokisi ane mativi akatwasuka.

entries.name: Kuoma kwemashizha (northern leaf blight)
entries.signs: Mavara marefu akaita sefodya kana chikepe egrey-girini kusvika brown pamashizha, achitangira pasi achikwira kumusoro kana kuchitonhora uye kunyorova.
entries.checkInField: Yera mamwe mavara: mavara marefu (macm akati wandei) ane chimiro chezai anoratidza blight.

entries.name: Bise (striga)
entries.signs: Chibage hachikuri, chinoita yellow uye kusvava kunyange paine mvura, paine sora diki rine maruva epinki kana pepuru pazasi pemiti.
entries.checkInField: Tarisa pazasi pemiti yabatwa kuti pane sora diki rine maruva epinki kana pepuru; chera zvakanaka uone kana rakabatana nemidzi.
